results.content: # Domain Randomization for Sim2Real Transfer. In Robotics, one of the hardest problems is how to make your model transfer to the real world. Due to the sample inefficiency of deep RL algorithms and the cost of data collection on real robots, we often need to train models in a simulator which theoretically provides an infinite amount of data. To close the sim2real gap, we need to improve the simulator and make it closer to reality. To make the definition more general, let us call the environment that we have full access to (i.e. simulator) **source domain** and the environment that we would like to transfer the model to **target domain** (i.e. physical world). We can control a set of $N$ randomization parameters in the source domain $e\_\xi$ with a configuration $\xi$, sampled from a randomization space, $\xi \in \Xi \subset \mathbb{R}^N$.
